scripts.generate: mustache config/$NETWORK.json template.yaml > subgraph.yaml && mustache config/$NETWORK.json src/constants/index.template.ts > src/constants/index.ts && graph codegen
scripts.deploy-goldsky-sepolia: NETWORK=sepolia npm run generate && npm run build && goldsky subgraph deploy dripswap-v2-sepolia/$npm_package_version --path .
scripts.deploy-goldsky-scroll: NETWORK=scroll-sepolia npm run generate && npm run build && goldsky subgraph deploy dripswap-v2-scroll-sepolia/$npm_package_version --path .
